definition: Normal support witness with finite support set S and selected support measure tuple.
input_witness_condition: witness in support normal form W=(S,payload,certificate)
relation_to_family_chain_lift: May be recognized or non-recognized family-chain source.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: Non-normal input is outside selected operation.

definition: A coordinate c in S unused by obstruction payload, counterexample certificate, active support, and recognized family-chain lift payload when present.
input_witness_condition: c in S and redundancy predicate holds
canonicalization_effect: canonical rows do not require c
relation_to_family_chain_lift: Family-chain recognized lift remains valid only if c outside lifted payload.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: If no such c exists, route to next operation or escape.
caveat: Existence of c for arbitrary witness is not proved.

definition: Restrict W to S without c and renormalize by the existing support normal-form projection.
payload_effect: payload restriction is identical on active coordinates
relation_to_family_chain_lift: Recognized source form is preserved if family-chain fields do not mention c.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: If renormalization fails, classify named operation failure.
caveat: Normal-form preservation is proof-sketch, not full proof.

definition: Compare lexicographic tuple before and after deletion.
caveat: Assumes finite support tuple selected in support_bound_measure.

definition: Payload components not mentioning c are unchanged after restriction.
counterexample_status_effect: counterexample payload unchanged on active coordinates
relation_to_family_chain_lift: Family-chain payload preserved if c is not a family-chain coordinate.
caveat: Requires payload-refinement sublemma for arbitrary payload equivalence.

definition: If c is absent from the counterexample certificate, the same certificate witnesses the output or refutes minimality.
counterexample_status_effect: preserved or reduced to smaller witness
relation_to_family_chain_lift: family-chain status preserved only under recognized-source compatibility.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: If certificate uses c, operation precondition fails.

definition: Failure to satisfy redundancy is not a proof failure for other operations.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: Higher-support escape only after all declared operations fail.

definition: Selected operation semantics are first-class and proof-ready with measure decrease proved under redundancy precondition.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: named operation failure if precondition absent
